sources.title: zerotts · PyPI
sources.snippet: ZeroTTS's time-to-first-audio comes from its real streaming path — first audio frame, not first full utterance. The three baselines have no working CPU streaming path, so their TTFA is the time to the complete utterance.

sources.title: GitHub - hadeskers/zerotts: Fast, lightweight zero-shot Vietnamese text ...
sources.snippet: Vietnamese Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech (TTS) with real-time streaming and voice cloning from seconds of audio. Fast, natural, and optimised for CPU inference. The most accurate open Vietnamese TTS we know of — 4× fewer word errors than the next open model, and it runs faster than real time on a laptop CPU.
